title: Schumer blames Trump policies for weakening employment
text:
President Donald Trump's reckless economic experiment is failing American workers. The latest jobs report is a warning that his chaotic tariffs, weak trade deals, and other damaging decisions have slowed hiring while families pay more for necessities. Working people are being pushed toward the breaking point so the president can continue policies that reward the wealthy and well connected.

Republican senators should stop defending this failed agenda and admit the harm it is causing. Senate Democrats will force votes to reverse the tariffs and provide relief for families. Lawmakers now face a clear choice: protect ordinary Americans from rising costs and disappearing opportunities, or continue following Trump while his policies weaken the economy.
label: Left
